currentParagraphText: “Human... you’re strong... too strong...” the Chieftain said as he breathed heavily. “I’m... inferior. Please, tell me... was I a good opponent? Did I fight well?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Human... you’re strong... too strong...” the Chieftain said as he breathed heavily. “I’m... inferior. Please, tell me... was I a good opponent? Did I fight well?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “You did your best, and that’s all anyone can ever ask for,” Jake simply responded, not willing to lie but also respecting his opponent enough to give him this last moment of dignity.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jake was no longer in a hurry as he walked around the kneeling body of the ape. The spirit energy around his body had already started to fade as his skin was rotten in several places from all the poison coursing through his veins. They both knew the fight was over even as Jake got in front of the Chieftain, who looked up with tired eyes.
